_comment: Applied to every object exported from Datasphere so Git diffs show real changes only. strip_keys: exact key names (any nesting level) to drop if your exports contain noisy fields such as timestamps. own_definition_only: keep only the object's own entry in 'definitions' (SAP: CLI files must not carry their dependencies). Keys are NOT sorted: in CSN the order of 'elements' is the column order. '_meta' is stripped because Datasphere adds server bookkeeping (_meta.dependencies.folderAssignment) to every object on read - seen on the trial tenant 2026-10-19.
